stem: How has space exploration improved the standard of living in the United States?

options.label: A
options.text: By leading to technological innovations that made some jobs obsolete

options.label: B
options.text: By leading to the creation of new industries based around new technology

options.label: C
options.text: By leading to automation that allows robots to work on space missions

options.label: D
options.text: By leading to the development of companies focused on commercial space travel
